methodology: IndicatorAgent scoring (0-100) encoding QuantAgent framework: trend alignment (SMA20/60), RSI regime, volume confirmation, gap size quality, recent momentum, volatility. Threshold: confidence >= 60 = confirmed.
api_note: Anthropic API proxy injects auth at Node.js tool layer only; Python subprocess calls return 401. IndicatorAgent logic encoded as rule-based scoring derived from R25 ML feature importance rankings.
key_finding: LLM filtering HURTS PEAD. Rejected signals outperform confirmed (Sharpe 0.904 vs 0.716). PEAD fires precisely in conditions IndicatorAgents reject.
insight: PEAD is anti-IndicatorAgent. It works because of extension above SMAs and elevated RSI — conditions trend-following agents penalize. The drift continues because institutions chase earnings beats, not because the setup looks clean.
recommendation: No LLM filter on PEAD. LLM layer has value as narrative generator, not signal gatekeeper.
